title: 第1章 飞仙宗苏梦儿第2章 招收大会争锋相对
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
天元大陆。
东荒。
飞仙宗。
一座充满绿意盎然的山峰之上，坐落着一间朴实无华的院子。
在院子中，有一名身穿白衣的青年正悠哉悠哉的躺在一张摇椅之上，看上去很是悠然。
山峰名为灵药峰，是飞仙宗专门培育灵药的地方。
而院子中的青年，便是这灵药峰的峰主，名为李如风。
但没人知道是，如今的李如风，已经不是当初的李如风，而是一名穿越者。
两年半前，身处蓝星的李如风因为997猝死在工作岗位上。
也许是他运气好，上天给了他一次重活一世的机会，让他穿越到飞仙宗跟他同名同姓的李如风身上。
不仅如此，李如风还激活了穿越必备的金手指——无敌签到系统。
正如名字一样，该系统最大的功能就是签到。
签到分为日签、月签、年签，以及特殊地点签到。
在激活签到系统的那一刻，李如风便毫不犹豫的就选择了第一次签到。
只是让李如风没有想到的是，当时系统就直接给了他亿年的修为。
天元大陆，境界由低到高分为炼气、筑基、金丹、元婴、化神、炼虚、渡劫、大乘、圣人、圣王、圣皇、圣尊、至圣、古圣、大圣、准帝、大帝，且每层境界都细分为九重。
而李如风仅仅是使用了一万年的修为，就让原本修为尽废的他瞬间一跃成了大帝九重的巅峰强者。
开局便是无敌，这让上辈子因为生活而累成狗的李如风直接选择了躺平。
于是，在接下来的两年半时间中，李如风除了签到，就是给灵药峰的灵药浇浇水。
剩下的空暇时光，他就躺在院子中享受着温暖的阳光。

期间，各种顶级功法武技，亦或是武器丹药等物品，李如风签到了满满一系统空间。
若是这些东西拿出来，起码要堆成好几个山头那么高。
……
“师叔，我又来了！”
就在李如风跟往常一般躺着晒太阳的时候，山脚下，一道清脆灵动的声音传入他的耳中。
下一刻，悠闲自得的李如风缓缓睁开了那微闭的双眼。
不一会，一道身影便一蹦一跳的来到李如风的院子中。
“原来是小梦儿啊。”
“你今天怎么有空来我这里？”
李如风扫了一眼出现在他面前的身影，随后缓缓开口问道。
小梦儿，全名苏梦儿，乃是飞仙宗宗主的徒弟，从小就展现出非凡的修炼天赋。
如今不过十岁的年纪，就已经是炼气九重，只差一步，就能突破到筑基境。
而自从李如风修为被废后来到灵药峰当峰主，苏梦儿就经常来这里看望李如风。
相比较宗门其他弟子的冷淡，苏梦儿对李如风，脸上总是露出那天真可爱的笑容。
“嘿嘿，师叔，我来找你玩啊。”
“顺便帮你给灵药浇浇水。”
“这么一座山峰的药园，要是只有师叔你一个人，肯定要浇到天黑的。”
content_en:
Tianyuan Continent.
Donghuang.
Feixian Sect.
On top of a mountain full of greenery sits an unpretentious courtyard.
In the yard, a young man in white clothes was lying leisurely on a rocking chair, looking very leisurely.
The mountain peak is called Spiritual Medicine Peak, and it is the place where Feixian Sect specializes in cultivating spiritual medicine.
The young man in the courtyard is the peak master of the Spiritual Medicine Peak, named Li Rufeng.
But no one knows that Li Rufeng today is no longer the Li Rufeng he was before, but a time traveler.
Two and a half years ago, Li Rufeng, who was working in Blue Star, died suddenly at work due to 997.
Perhaps because of his good luck, God gave him a chance to live a new life, allowing him to travel back in time to Li Rufeng, who had the same name and surname as him in the Feixian Sect.
Not only that, Li Rufeng also activated the invincible sign-in system, a must-have cheat for time travel.
As the name suggests, the biggest function of this system is check-in.
Sign-in is divided into daily sign-in, monthly sign-in, annual sign-in, and sign-in at special locations.
The moment the sign-in system was activated, Li Rufeng chose to sign in for the first time without hesitation.
What Li Rufeng didn't expect was that the system directly gave him hundreds of millions of years of cultivation.
In Tianyuan Continent, the realms from low to high are divided into Qi Refining, Foundation Building, Golden Elixir, Nascent Soul, Divine Transformation, Void Refining, Tribulation Transcendence, Mahayana, Saint, Saint King, Saint Emperor, Holy Honor, Supreme Saint, Ancient Saint, Great Saint, Quasi-Emperor, and Great Emperor, and each realm is subdivided into nine levels.
And Li Rufeng just used ten thousand years of cultivation, and he instantly became a peak expert at the ninth level of the Great Emperor.
He was invincible at the beginning, which made Li Rufeng, who was exhausted from life in his previous life, just choose to lie down.
So, in the next two and a half years, apart from signing in, Li Rufeng watered the elixirs at the elixir peak.
During the rest of his free time, he lay in the yard enjoying the warm sunshine.
During this period, Li Rufeng filled up the system space with various top-notch martial arts, weapons, pills and other items.
If these things were taken out, they would be piled at least as high as several hills.
…
"Uncle Master, I'm here again!"
Just when Li Rufeng was lying down and basking in the sun as usual, a crisp and clear voice came into his ears at the foot of the mountain.
The next moment, the leisurely and contented Li Rufeng slowly opened his slightly closed eyes.
After a while, a figure jumped into Li Rufeng's yard.
"It turns out to be Xiao Meng'er."
"Why do you have time to come to my place today?"
Li Rufeng glanced at the figure that appeared in front of him, and then slowly asked.
Xiao Meng'er, whose full name is Su Meng'er, is the disciple of the master of Feixian Sect. She has shown extraordinary talent in cultivation since she was a child.
Now, at only ten years old, he is already at the ninth level of Qi Refining, and is only one step away from breaking through to the foundation building realm.
And ever since Li Rufeng came to Spiritual Medicine Peak as the peak master after being deposed, Su Meng'er has often come here to visit Li Rufeng.
Compared to the indifference of other disciples in the sect, Su Meng'er always had an innocent and cute smile on her face towards Li Rufeng.
"Hey, uncle, I came to play with you."
"By the way, I'll help you water the elixir."
"If you were the only one in the medicinal garden on such a mountain peak, you would definitely have to water it until dark."
